Calculate the distance between pairs of randomly sampled spot in each
sub-cluster Distance functions

```{r}
# Manhattan
manhattan.distance <- function(x, y) return(sum(abs(x-y)))

# cosine
cosine.similarity <- function(x, y) return(sum(x*y) / (sqrt(sum(x^2))*sqrt(sum(y^2))))
cosine.distance <- function(x, y) return(1 - cosine.similarity(x, y))

# euclidean
euclidean.distance <- function(x, y) return(sqrt(sum((x - y)^2)))

# spearman 
spearman.cor <- function(x, y) return(cor(x, y, method="spearman"))
spearman.distance <- function(x, y) return(1 - abs(spearman.cor(x, y)))

# pearson 
pearson.cor <- function(x, y) return(cor(x, y, method="pearson"))
pearson.distance <- function(x, y) return(1 - abs(pearson.cor(x, y)))

func <- list(
    "manhattan" = manhattan.distance,
    "cosine" = cosine.distance,
    "euclidean" = euclidean.distance,
    "spearman" = spearman.distance,
    "pearson" = pearson.distance
)
```

Calculate the pairwise distances between cells

```{r}
# the function to use
for (metric in c("euclidean")) {
    distance.function <- func[[metric]]
    
    # calculate
    input.data <- GetAssayData(sp_xylem, assay = "SCT", layer = "data")
    cell.distance <- CustomDistance(input.data, my.function = distance.function)
    cell.distance <- as.matrix(cell.distance)
    
    # sampling
    distances <- data.frame(matrix(nrow = 0, ncol = 4))
    set.seed(42)
    for (sub_cluster in c("early", "mid", "late")) {
        cells <- rownames(sp_xylem@meta.data[sp_xylem@meta.data$cluster == sub_cluster, ])
        for (i in 1:100) {
            sampled <- sample(cells, size = 2, replace = FALSE)
            sampled <- sort(sampled)
            distance <- cell.distance[sampled[1], sampled[2]]
            distances <- rbind(distances, list(sub_cluster, sampled[1], sampled[2], distance))
        }
    }
    colnames(distances) <- c("sub_cluster", "cell_1", "cell_2", "distance")
    
    p <- ggplot(distances, aes(
        x = factor(
            sub_cluster,
            levels = c("early", "mid", "late")
        ), 
        y = distance
    )) + 
        geom_violin(
            aes(colour = sub_cluster)
        ) + 
        geom_jitter(aes(colour = sub_cluster), width = 0.2, size = .5) + 
        # stat_summary(fun = "mean", geom = "point") + 
        theme_classic() +
        theme(legend.position = "none") +
        labs(
            x = NULL,
            y = NULL,
            title = NULL
            # sprintf(
            # "%s distance between 100 pairs of randomly sampled spots\nfrom each sub-cluster",
            # metric)
        ) +
        scale_color_manual(values = c(
            "early" = "#9F005A", 
            "mid" = "#30638E", 
            "late" = "#FF8811"))
    
    # save plot
    svg(
        filename = sprintf(
            "outputs/notebook/Spatial/intra-cluster_%s-distance_by_sub-cluster_normalized.svg",
            metric
        ), 
        width = 3,
        height = 3
    )
    print(p)
    dev.off()
    
    # ggsave(
    #     filename = sprintf(
    #         "outputs/notebook/Spatial/intra-cluster_%s-distance_by_sub-cluster_normalized.svg",
    #         metric
    #     ),
    #     width = 8,
    #     height = 8
    # )
}
# print(p)
# dev.off()
```

```{r}
res <- wilcox.test(
    subset(distances, distances$sub_cluster == "early")$distance,
    subset(distances, distances$sub_cluster == "mid")$distance,
    paired = FALSE,
    alternative = "greater"
)
res
```

)

# Integrate single-cell & spatial data (deconvolution)

```{r}
# remove outlier cells
sc_data <- subset(sc_data, idents = c("outlier1", "outlier2", "outlier3"), invert = TRUE)
counts <- sc_data[["RNA"]]$counts
cluster <- as.factor(sc_data$cluster)
nUMI <- sc_data$nCount_RNA
levels(cluster) <- gsub("/", "-", levels(cluster))
cluster <- droplevels(cluster)

# create the RCTD reference object
reference <- Reference(counts, cluster, nUMI)

counts_hd <- sp_xylem[["Spatial"]]$counts
xylem_cells_hd <- colnames(sp_xylem[["Spatial"]])
coords <- GetTissueCoordinates(sp_xylem)[xylem_cells_hd, 1:2]

# create the RCTD query object
query <- SpatialRNA(coords, counts_hd, colSums(counts_hd))
```

```{r}
# run RCTD
RCTD <- create.RCTD(query, reference, max_cores = 28)
RCTD <- run.RCTD(RCTD, doublet_mode = "doublet")
# add results back to Seurat object
sp_xylem <- AddMetaData(sp_xylem, metadata = RCTD@results$results_df)
```

```{r}
sp_xylem$celltypes <- paste(
    RCTD@results$results_df$first_type,
    RCTD@results$results_df$second_type,
    sep = "-"
)
p <- SpatialDimPlot(sp_xylem, group.by = "first_type")
ggsave(
    filename = "outputs/notebook/Spatial/RCTD_first_type.png",
    width = 8,
    height = 8
)
p
```

Find the nearest single-cell data point to each spatial data point

```{r}
dist_on_integrated_reduc <- dist(Embeddings(merged, reduction = "integrated.cca"))
dist_on_integrated_reduc <- as.matrix(dist_on_integrated_reduc)
dist_on_integrated_reduc <- dist_on_integrated_reduc[Cells(sp_xylem), Cells(sc_data)]
nearest_sc_cell_to_sp_xylem <- apply(dist_on_integrated_reduc, 1, function(x)(names(which.min(x))))
sc_annotated_sp_xylem <- paste("sp", merged@meta.data[nearest_sc_cell_to_sp_xylem, "cluster"], sep = "-")
merged@meta.data[Cells(sp_xylem), "cluster"] <- sc_annotated_sp_xylem
```

# Give biological meanings to spatial data

Spatial data and single-cell data are poorly integrated. We doubt
whether data from these to technologies can be integrated. Instead of
trying to integrate the two datasets, we now focus on spatial
transcriptome data itself. We will inspect the expression level of wood
formation related genes across the cross-section and see whether it
captures process of wood formation.

Continued from ![Record clustering
results](##%20Record%20clustering%20results)

```{r}
sp_xylem
VariableFeaturePlot(sp_xylem)
```

    "references/Ptr/annotation/Ptrichocarpa_533_v4.1.annotation_info.txt",

    comment.char = ""
)
annot_info

## Plot expression level of DEGs

### Mid vs. Early

```{r}
DEA_mid_vs_early <- FindMarkers(sp_xylem, ident.1 = "mid", ident.2 = "early", test.use = "wilcox")
cat("Found N DEG:", sum(DEA_mid_vs_early$p_val_adj < 0.05))
p <- SpatialFeaturePlot(
    sp_xylem, 
    slot = "data", 
    features = rownames(DEA_mid_vs_early[DEA_mid_vs_early$p_val_adj < 0.05, ][1:15, ]), 
    ncol = 5
)
ggsave(
    "outputs/notebook/Spatial/FeaturePlot_DEA_mid_vs_early_top15.png",
    width = 20,
    height = 12
)
```

Export DEA data.frame

```{r}
DEA_table <- DEA_mid_vs_early
DEA_table$best_arabi_gene <- ""
for (i in 1:nrow(DEA_table)) {
    ptr_gene <- substr(rownames(DEA_table[i, ]), 1, 16)
    ath_gene <- subset(annot_info, annot_info$locusName == ptr_gene)$best_arabi_gene[1]
    if (length(ath_gene) != 0) {
        DEA_table[i, "best_arabi_gene"] <- ath_gene
    }
}
write.csv(
    DEA_table,
    "outputs/notebook/Spatial/DEA_mid_vs_early.csv"
)
cat(subset(DEA_table, (DEA_table$p_val_adj < 0.05) & (DEA_table$avg_log2FC > 0))$best_arabi_gene, sep = "\n")
```
